model.title: A resolution to authorize testimony and representation by the Senate Legal Counsel.

summary.text: The resolution allows employees of Senator Elizabeth Warren's office who may hold relevant evidence to give testimony in a current investigation and any future legal proceedings on the same matter, except on subjects where a legal privilege applies. It also authorizes the Senate Legal Counsel to represent those employees in connection with giving that testimony.
